stageNote: Authored alongside scopes.md. Each scenarioId maps one-to-one onto the matching BS-025-NNN identifier in spec.md. scopeId and scope name the owning scope in scopes.md. testRows name the Test Plan row identifiers in scopes.md. linkedTests and evidenceRefs stay empty because no test file exists and no command has run, so populating them would be fabricated linkage. behaviorTraits are derived per scenario from what that scenario actually does, and each obligation names the trait that implies it plus the planned test that discharges it.
businessScenarioMapping: SCN-025-001 through SCN-025-024 map one-to-one onto BS-025-001 through BS-025-024 in spec.md. No identifier is reused and no identifier is skipped.
